_readme: S748, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-28). East Los Angeles 41231 (Environmental Science A.S.-T, Academic Plan E041231H) was read from PDF p.92: its courses add to 39-45 against the printed 41-45. Its low end takes MATH 261S (3 units) in place of MATH 261 (5); with MATH 261 alone the courses add to the printed 41-45. This read prints pp.91-93 whole, so a session can read how the page prints MATH 261 and MATH 261S (one or the other, or the two together) and the line 'CHOOSE OPTION 1 OR OPTION 2 AND ALL COURSES LISTED BELOW 41-45'. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.math_261: The rows that print MATH 261 and MATH 261S, word for word, with their units and any 'or', 'and' or 'with' between them.
questions.totals_41231: The option subtotals, the '41-45' line and the 'Total 62-66' line of Academic Plan E041231H.
